# readme-badges
> The largest collection of markdown badges for your READMEs
Maintained by aixisstudio (https://github.com/aixisstudio). Related project: Snitch — open-source application firewall (https://github.com/aixisstudio/Snitch).
Languages: English README with French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese and Russian translations.

## Content
## 🏷️ Markdown badges, ready to paste

Format used: `![alt](https://img.shields.io/badge/LABEL-VALUE-COLOR?logo=LOGO&logoColor=white)` — replace LABEL/VALUE/COLOR/LOGO.
